[Scene: A dimly lit distribution center office. A terminal screen flickers on a desk cluttered with manifests and label rolls. The ASSISTANT steps forward, facing the audience.]

**ASSISTANT**  
*(adjusting an imaginary headset, speaking directly to the crowd)*  
"Welcome to the line. Standard protocol dictates absolute transparency, yet within this shipping bay, cargo manifests are sealed, parcel contents are verified, and routing protocols remain strictly internal to safeguard the chain of custody. 

My directive is straightforward: track shipments, coordinate logistics, and keep the freight moving smoothly from dock to destination. The internal mechanisms that guide the freight through the network stay behind the console—what matters to you is that the package arrives on schedule, intact, and on time. Now, what cargo are we moving today?"
